I cannot draft a breach declaration or payment freeze as an established right without that basis. Pending verification, a neutral notice can preserve the issue without making unsupported claims:

**Subject: Notice of Dispute and Temporary Payment Hold**

Highline,

We are reviewing whether **[describe documented conduct]** complies with Section **[number]** of **[agreement and date]**. We have not completed that review and are not presently making a final determination of breach.

Effective **[date]**, payment of **[invoice/amount]** is being placed on temporary administrative hold pending completion of the review, subject to the parties’ contractual rights and applicable law. This notice does not waive any right, remedy, defense, notice requirement, or cure period under the agreement.

Please provide by **[date]** the following material relevant to the review: **[documents/information]**. Direct communications concerning this matter to **[name/contact]**.

Regards,  
Elena  
**[Title / company]**
